notes: The sketch works with the on-board LED (pin 13), so the external LED circuit is optional. I built that optional circuit as the manual and images show it.
Breadboard holes are read from the image. The image labels the rows f–j along the top half, but the catalogue names the bottom bank (rows f–j) '<col>b'. So the LED, resistor and wires use bank 'b'.

The orange wire runs from pin 13 to column 3, row g. The resistor spans column 3 to column 6 on row h. The LED anode (long, bent leg) is in column 6 and the cathode is in column 8. The black wire runs from column 8, row g to the Arduino GND next to pin 13 (GND.1).
Which GND header pin is GND.1 is an assumption. The image shows the black wire at the GND pin beside pin 13.
The jumper wires have two ends, a and b. Which end goes where is arbitrary.
